analysis: Price has accepted above VAH at $60,318, but the move is heavily driven by derivative buying with Perp CVD (+443.04) significantly outstripping Spot CVD (+69.04). Without aggressive spot accumulation to back the breakout, the advance remains highly vulnerable to leverage exhaustion.
key_risk: Failure of spot buyers to support the expansion, risking a sharp re-entry and long liquidation cascade back inside the Value Area below $59,950.
